content: TanStack Table v8 editable cells: defaultColumn.cell uses local useState + onBlur calling table.options.meta.updateData(rowIndex, columnId, value). Row selection: display column with header checkbox (table.getIsAllRowsSelected/getToggleAllRowsSelectedHandler) and cell checkbox (row.getIsSelected/getToggleSelectedHandler); use getRowId for stable ids; read selected via table.getSelectedRowModel().rows.
